name: @latticekit/example-canyon
description: CANYON — a gallery exhibit. A river cutting a gorge over a million years, scrubbable, and the ground never stops moving.
$comment: Five of nine. @latticekit/sim has no economy to run and @latticekit/persist nothing to save — the timeline is not a save, it is a re-run from a seed, which is the whole point of the exhibit and is precisely why it needs no store. @latticekit/audio is absent for the reason the gallery has not settled: a page that starts making noise before a visitor has touched it is worse than a silent one. @latticekit/input is here through the shared bootstrap rather than by name: the camera is the whole canvas interaction, and the one control that is not the camera is a DOM range input, because @latticekit/ui has no slider — see src/hud.ts.
